map.name: Tharsis-inspired prototype
map.note: Provisional coordinates and bonuses, not verified as a faithful official map.

tiles.ocean: Reserved ocean spaces only; neutral; TR +1; adjacent ocean gives 2 MC to later tile placements.
tiles.greenery: Must be adjacent to own tile if possible; raise oxygen and TR only if oxygen can increase.
tiles.city: Cannot be adjacent to another city; owned; base city standard project increases MC production.
tiles.placement: Take printed space bonuses and 2 MC per adjacent ocean.

limitations: Map layout/bonus locations are provisional and require verification against the exact official board.
Card catalog contains only original sample records, not all official or expansion cards.
Card-specific placement exceptions, corporations/preludes, and complete solo win rules are not implemented.
